identity.title: Super-resolution Imaging of the Protoplanetary Disk HD 142527 Using Sparse Modeling

question.value: Can sparse modeling (l1+TSV) imaging applied to ALMA data reproduce super-resolution structure (finer than the beam) of the HD 142527 disk with higher fidelity than MS-CLEAN?

evidence.loc: Introduction
evidence.quote: it has not yet been applied to ALMA observational data, and it is therefore unknown whether SpM imaging is useful for the reconstruction of super-resolution images based on actual observational data.

method.value: l1+TSV regularized least squares solved with MFISTA on cell-averaged gridded visibilities; one image per spectral window, four averaged

fitting.value: Convex optimization; parameters chosen by minimum 10-fold CV error per spectral window
